join_query.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    t1.match_id AS match_id,
    t2.run_id AS run_id,
    t1.match_status AS match_status,
    t1.list_id AS list_id,
    t1.matched_name AS matched_name,
    t1.match_score AS match_score,
    t1.created_at AS created_at
FROM aml_screening_match t1
JOIN aml_screening_subject t2 ON t1.subject_id = t2.subject_id

join_query.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    t1.customer_id AS customer_id,
    t3.screening_id AS screening_id,
    t3.screened_at AS screened_at,
    t1.account_id AS account_id
FROM account t1
JOIN funds_transfer t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.debit_account_id
JOIN payment_screening t3 ON t2.ft_id = t3.ft_id
